factions.name: United Federation of Planets

signature.desc: Integrate other species via diplomacy; each member grants a unique bonus (Vulcan: research, Andorian: military, Tellarite: engineering, Bajoran: faith/morale).

factions.weakness: Ships expensive; slow to declare war (council vote).

factions.name: Klingon Empire

signature.desc: Earn Honor from combat and victories; spend it to call on Great Houses for ships, or lose it and risk civil war.

factions.weakness: Weak economy and research; dishonorable acts (fleeing, sneak attacks on allies) cost Honor.
factions.home: Qo'noS (Praxis moon — can explode in TOS era)

factions.name: Romulan Star Empire

signature.desc: Espionage ops: steal tech, incite unrest, assassinate captains. Cloaks on almost every hull.

factions.weakness: Singularity-core ships leave gravity wells when destroyed; paranoid internal politics.

factions.name: Cardassian Union

signature.desc: Conquered colonies produce +50% but generate Resistance; ore-processing stations double refined output.

factions.weakness: Resistance cells; ships individually weaker than Federation equivalents.

factions.name: The Dominion

signature.desc: Jem'Hadar are cheap and fearless but need White; supply cut-off makes them go feral.

factions.weakness: Dependent on White and on a wormhole/supply link to the Gamma Quadrant.

factions.name: Ferengi Alliance

signature.desc: Unlockable Rules grant economic perks; can buy foreign ships, modules and mercenaries with Latinum.

factions.weakness: Weak native military; Latinum loss cripples them.

factions.name: Borg Collective

signature.desc: Shields adapt to weapon types used repeatedly against the Collective; assimilate ships, tech and population.

factions.weakness: Can't trade or ally; frequency-rotation and multi-weapon strategies counter adaptation.
